prd_facts.fact: A return must start within 30 days after delivery for standard customers and within 60 days for VIP customers.
The VIP window is a tunable number in the config key returns.vip_window_days with default 60; the standard window stays in returns.window_days with default 30.
A return is allowed only on a delivered or partially refunded order, and the window counts from delivery.
Other return rules (gift cards and grocery excluded, quantity limits, refund amounts, restock, points taken back) do not change.
The change is recorded in the PRD changelog.
